about: How the ChatGPT/Codex package differs from the repo skills. The /chatgpt endpoint serves only the tools in chatgpt-tools.json: no Blender or Adobe bridges, no ask_mira, no trends, no raw uploads (chat attachments arrive through the client). The package is English only: `stripCyrillicTriggers` drops the quoted non-English trigger phrases from every shipped SKILL.md description, and rewrites cover the rest. Every `find` must match the source exactly once, so the build fails as soon as a source edit makes a rewrite stale. `override` files replace a source file whole; `sha256` is the source they were written against, and check.mjs fails when the source moves on without them.
